records.subject: Welcome aboard, Harbor Media
records.body:
Hi Kai,

Thanks for setting up Harbor Media on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

draft.subject: Quick help getting Harbor Media's first tasks moving
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

Thanks for making time for the kickoff last week — good to see Harbor Media's first project already set up, and an invite out to a teammate.

Since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, the next step is getting real work into that project so your team has something shared to work from. If it's useful, teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Happy to jump on a short call this week and help you map your current work into that first project — just tell me a time that suits.

Best,
Chidi
